page.overview:
Who is J. Nzenwa?

J. Nzenwa was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century. This individual had served under Admiral Leyton.

In 2372, this individual was assigned as a Senior Hygienist, Starfleet Dental. The effective date of this assignment was 49330. This officer was one of over four hundred officers reassigned in a three week period by Leyton. This officer's name was listed in the personnel assignment log that was displayed on a screen in Benjamin Sisko's temporary office in Starfleet Headquarters. (, okudagram)
